offering_description.value: Korn Ferry recruits executives, permanent staff and interim professionals for companies, institutions and government agencies. It also advises employers on organizational design, pay and leadership development, runs outsourced recruiting programs and provides talent software and workforce data.

primary_products.value: Talent assessment software; compensation benchmarking databases; job architecture tools; leadership development platforms

primary_services.value: Retained executive search; organizational and talent consulting; permanent professional recruitment; interim staffing; recruitment process outsourcing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Employers, boards, private equity firms and nonprofit institutions; B2G: Government agencies and public institutions hiring leaders or managing their workforces

end_markets.value: Financial services; industrial and manufacturing; technology; healthcare and life sciences; consumer goods and retail

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Retained executive searches, consulting engagements and outsourced recruiting programs; service fees: Permanent professional placements and interim staffing assignments; subscription: Recurring access to talent software and compensation benchmarking data; licensing or royalties: Rights to use assessment tools and leadership development content
revenue_model.category: project or contract; service fees; subscription; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses candidate networks and workforce research to deliver recruiting, staffing and consulting to employers; software / platform: Combines assessment methods and pay data in digital tools for HR teams

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Executive search, organizational consulting, professional recruitment and interim staffing, outsourced recruiting, and talent software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Search partners, consultants and enterprise account teams; online: Web portals for assessments, benchmarking and leadership development

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Recruiting, staffing and candidate data handling are subject to employment, anti-discrimination and privacy laws.
